description: Checks a LIST of Spanish customers (up to 100) before invoicing them (VERI*FACTU, e-invoicing): for each tax ID, whether the format is valid, whether the company is registered, its legal name and registered office, its status and, if you pass the name you hold, whether it matches. Returns invoice_hint ok / revisar (review) / no_facturar (do not invoice) with the reasons (struck off, absorbed, insolvent, tax ID revoked by the Tax Agency, name mismatch, sample tax ID...). Use it to review the customer base of an invoicing program or ERP; to onboard a single customer in more detail, use verify_company. It does not replace the Tax Agency census. Pro or Business plan, or credits; uses 1 request per company found (tax IDs not found are free). Validar el NIF de los clientes antes de facturar.

cif.description: Customer tax ID (CIF, DNI or NIE)

name.description: Legal name you hold, to check that it matches the registered one

ref.description: Your own customer identifier; returned as is

vat.description: true to also check the EU VAT number in VIES (only with 20 customers or fewer)

name: verify_invoice_recipients
title: Check invoice recipients' tax IDs
